claims.quote: The African blackfin barb, Enteromius guirali, is a cyprinid recorded only from Cameroon and Gabon, including the Sanaga and Ogoué basins.

regions.name: Sanaga
regions.quote: It has been recorded from most of the major south and westerly river basins including the Ntem, Nyong, Dja and Sanaga.

regions.name: Ogooué
regions.quote: In Gabon it occurs in the great Ogooué River basin which drains virtually the entire country as well as the Ngouné and Ivindo, two of its main tributaries.
